name: mas-script-specialized-adapter
description: Review, add, or refactor AUTO-MAS specialized script adapters by upstream architecture, including MAA, SRC, MaaEnd/MXU, General, ok-script adapters such as Okww and OkNte, multi-engine adapters such as HSR, and the one-dragon line such as BetterGI, as well as per-adapter issue-bundle exports. Use when lowering user setup friction, judging whether a change stays inside the black-box boundary (barrier first, then capability ownership), or changing ScriptType registration, task lifecycle, config ownership, ScriptConfig sessions, Electron integration, frontend edit surfaces, and verification.

findings.excerpt: - schema 变更后离线导出再生成（`PYTHONPATH=. python .dev/export_openapi.py` → `npx openapi --input ../.dev/openapi.json`），禁止手改生成文件。
